subject: Insurance
title: The Gender Gap in Premiums
description: One-minute skill: The Gender Gap in Premiums.

hook.text: Women pay less for life insurance.

buildup.text: Women live about 5 years longer than men on average. Lower mortality risk means lower premiums.

discovery.text: Actuarial tables show the gap at every age. Men have higher death rates from heart disease, accidents, and violence.

twist.text: The EU banned gender-based pricing in 2012. European insurers now charge the same rate regardless of sex.

climax.text: Gender pricing is actuarially accurate but socially debated. Should biology determine your insurance cost?

punchline.text: Women live longer, pay less. Biology sets insurance prices—for now.

quiz.question: Why do women pay less for life insurance?
